title: Convergence rates for the RMSprop optimizer with full control of the hyperparameters
abstract: arXiv:2608.30382v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Popular adaptive stochastic gradient descent (SGD) methods to train artificial intelligence (AI) systems include the RMSprop, the Adam, and the AdamW optimizers, where the adaptivity parts in Adam and AdamW basically just coincide with RMSprop. Such adaptive methods involve several hyperparameters including the regularization parameter $\epsilon$ (which ensures that one does not divide by 0 and is often chosen to be very close to zero such as $10^{-8}$ in PyTorch by default) and the second moment decay parameter $\beta$ (which is often chosen to be very close to $1$ such as 0.99 (RMSprop) and 0.999 (Adam and AdamW) in PyTorch by default). Despite the high relevance of such methods, it remains an open research problem to provide error estimates for such methods with the error constants being not exploding but uniformly bounded with the respect to the hyperparameters, even in the situation of convex stochastic optimization problems. translated_title: 具有超参数完全控制的RMSprop优化器的收敛速率
translated_abstract: 用于训练人工智能（AI）系统的流行自适应随机梯度下降（SGD）方法包括RMSprop、Adam和AdamW优化器，其中Adam和AdamW的自适应部分基本上与RMSprop相同。这类自适应方法涉及多个超参数，包括正则化参数ε（它确保不会除以0，通常被选为非常接近零的值，例如在PyTorch中默认为10⁻⁸）以及二阶矩衰减参数β（通常被选为非常接近1的值，例如在PyTorch中RMSprop默认为0.99，Adam和AdamW默认为0.999）。尽管这类方法具有高度重要性，但即使是在凸随机优化问题的情形下，为这类方法提供误差常数相对于超参数不爆炸而是均匀有界的误差估计，仍然是一个开放的研究问题。
tldr: 本文针对RMSprop优化器给出了误差常数相对于超参数（如正则化参数ε和二阶矩衰减参数β）均匀有界而非爆炸的收敛速率估计，解决了凸随机优化中的一个开放性研究问题。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes convergence rate estimates for the RMSprop optimizer with error constants that are uniformly bounded, rather than exploding, with respect to hyperparameters such as ε and β, resolving an open research problem in convex stochastic optimization.
